entities.summary: Tawitawi Island is a Philippine island in the Sulu Archipelago between the Sulu Sea and Celebes Sea, about 64 kilometres east of Borneo. It is the main island of Tawi-Tawi Province, with a little more than half the province's 1,087.40 km2 land area.
